reference_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month of 2025
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT month, clicks,
  clicks - LAG(clicks) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change_clicks
FROM monthly

  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', spend_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, m.clicks, m.clicks - p.clicks AS change_clicks
FROM monthly m
LEFT JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
